9. Disabling AP Payment Transmission to the Bank
Procedure
Navigate to Setup and Maintenance.
Search for Manage Payment Process Profiles.
Open each highlighted payment process profile one at a time.
Open the Payment System tab.
Locate the Automatically Transmit Payment File After Formatting checkbox in the middle section.
Uncheck the checkbox.
Open the Reporting tab.
Locate Separate Remittance Advice settings.
Ensure Delivery Method is blank.
Click Save and Close near the upper-right section.
Repeat for all highlighted payment process profiles.
Expected Results
Task completes successfully without Oracle validation or save errors.
